cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant coastal metropolis famous for the Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and sparkling sunlit beaches.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Australia's cultural capital, renowned for its street art lanes, world-class coffee, and buzzing culinary scene.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A futuristic yet historic metropolis where neon skyscrapers coexist with ancient shrines and culinary excellence.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: The historic heart of traditional Japan, boasting thousands of classical Buddhist temples, gardens, and imperial palaces.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: A vibrant South American gem known for Christ the Redeemer, festive samba rhythms, and iconic Atlantic coastlines.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: Brazil's bustling financial and cultural hub with prestigious museums, striking architecture, and vibrant gastronomy.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site and the largest religious temple complex in the world, an architectural wonder of the Khmer Empire.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An ivory-white marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river, recognized worldwide as a pinnacle of Mughal art and eternal love.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A breathtaking island in the South Pacific known for its turquoise lagoon, vibrant coral reef, and idyllic overwater bungalows.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: One of the most famous golden sand beaches in the world, lined with lively promenade kiosks and dramatic mountain backdrops.
